edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the sender of the transfer, so the caller directly controls token movement.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance accounting.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
_msgSender simply returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender().
cooldown[to] is compared against and set from block.timestamp in _transfer.
block.timestamp is passed as the router deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before adjusting allowances.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
approve delegates to internal _approve.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee, which pushes ETH out to the fee wallets.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam to allocate team fees.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to redistribute fees.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side amounts.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate for conversion.
_takeTeam uses _getRate to scale the team fee.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
renounceOwnership reads and overwrites _owner.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by the onlyOwner check on _owner.
openTrading is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
setBots is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
removeStrictTxLimit is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
delBot is restricted to _owner via onlyOwner.
balanceOf reads the _rOwned mapping of the queried account.
_transferStandard updates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount for cooldown transfers.
removeStrictTxLimit rewrites _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping keyed with block.timestamp.
_transfer requires bots[from] and bots[to] to be false.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch of _transfer.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown and max-tx checks.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router.WETH() and calls the router.
openTrading assigns and uses uniswapV2Router for pair creation and liquidity.
openTrading stores the created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
manualswap authorization depends on _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization depends on _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee transfers half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] before subtracting.
openTrading checks and sets the tradingOpen flag.
inSwap is the lock toggled by lockTheSwap around the router call.
_getTValues uses _feeAddr1 as the reflection tax percentage.
_getTValues uses _feeAddr2 as the team tax percentage.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to skip fee and swap logic.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal as the token supply.
sendETHToFee performs native ETH transfers to externally controlled fee wallets.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call.
openTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with contract ETH.
transferFrom subtracts the amount from the allowance, an arithmetic operation on an untrusted quantity.
_transferStandard relies on reflection/token arithmetic that can mis-account on rate changes.
Native ETH value transfers can trigger the receiver, and ETH sent back enters through receive().
The router swap may forward ETH to this contract, invoking the receive() hook mid-transfer.
ETH received via receive() enlarges contract balance consumed by the swap/fee path in _transfer.
The 'from' parameter drives branch selection inside _transfer.
The 'to' parameter drives cooldown and pair checks inside _transfer.
The 'amount' parameter is compared to _maxTxAmount and later transferred.
The 'sender' parameter is debited and used for allowance lookup in transferFrom.
The 'recipient' parameter receives the credit in _transferStandard.
The 'tAmount' parameter feeds the reflection and token amount calculations.
The 'tokenAmount' parameter is approved and swapped for ETH.
The 'amount' parameter is halved and transferred to the fee wallets.
The 'bots_' array elements populate the blacklist mapping.
contractTokenBalance is passed to swapTokensForEth as the swap input.
contractETHBalance flows into sendETHToFee.
currentRate is the divisor result returned by _getRate.
The swap path array is supplied to the router swap operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'from' of _transfer is only meaningful as part of the _transfer dataflow and should be merged into it.
Parameter 'to' of _transfer only drives the internal branch logic of _transfer.
Parameter 'amount' of _transfer is consumed entirely by the _transfer check and transfer logic.
Parameter 'sender' of transferFrom is used only by transferFrom for debit and allowance lookup.
Parameter 'recipient' of _transferStandard is only used to credit balances inside it.
Parameter 'tAmount' of _transferStandard feeds only its own bookkeeping computation.
Parameter 'tokenAmount' of swapTokensForEth is used solely for the router swap.
Parameter 'amount' of sendETHToFee is only split and forwarded by sendETHToFee.
Parameter 'bots_' of setBots is consumed only by the setBots loop.
Local contractTokenBalance is produced in _transfer and consumed directly by swapTokensForEth.
Local contractETHBalance is produced in _transfer and consumed directly by sendETHToFee.
Local currentRate exists only inside _getRate and should collapse into that function.
Local path array is constructed in swapTokensForEth purely as input to the router swap operation.
